# google.cloud's mutating modules import `to_text` from the deprecated
# `ansible.module_utils._text` shim, so real prints the one-time "can be
# disabled" hint plus a [DEPRECATION WARNING] for it. krikri models those lines
# from the payload sources baked into collection_runtime_data.cr, which the
# capture environment does not carry for google.cloud (the round's compare
# masks warning text, and the issue itself is the exit code plus the
# "uses unimplemented plugin" lines). Disabling them keeps the case pinned to
# the behavior the issue is about, the same way 1660 pins the setting itself.
ANSIBLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS=False
